rule: NES: 1 backdrop shared by both layers, 4 background palettes of 3 entries on 16x16 areas, 4 sprite palettes of 3 entries plus transparency on 8x8 tiles; every entry is a data/nes_palette.json entry number
notes: written by tools/art/make_exterior_maps.py because no NES-PALETTES scene file existed for this tileset; same format as data/palettes/scene_ship.json
background palettes are the 4 groups the scene map actually spends, in tileset order

sprite palettes are the PLACEHOLDER char lane set, a copy of the background groups, so a character cannot add a 14th colour to the frame. A card that solves them for the cast that walks here writes its rows in this file and this generator keeps them: card t_dec4e92c solved southampton, westminster and winchester for the party's four walking sheets, and the same run keeps every judged row it finds
